title: Page 235
transc:
From Harrisburg Sept 12' 530 PM
For Adams Our operator at GreenCastle
reports the arrival of Enrolling officers
from Williamspt , left there at 9 AM
today wherry Entered Williamspt at 11 AM
yesterday & immediately commenced Crossing Potomac
passed about fifteen thousand Infantry seventy
five pieces Artillery & heavy wagon
trains over last night bulk of
Rebel Army still near Hagerstown now 
believed they will evacuate Md more
speedily than they Entered
will keep you advised
of all we get
signed A G Curtin
